messages:
miriam: Heads-up — I merged a small refactor moving k8s/helm into terraform-modules/helm and hoisted provider blocks. Now staging plan for payments is failing on a helm_release resource. Error below, anyone seen this before?

miriam: ```
Error: Provider configuration not present

  on .terraform/modules/helm_release/main.tf line 12, in resource \"helm_release\" \"payments\":
  12: resource \"helm_release\" \"payments\" {

No provider "helm" configured for this resource. You may need to provide a provider configuration for it.
```

ator: hmm, sounds like an alias/hoist mismatch. Did the module expect an implicit default provider?

miriam: Yes — child module's required_providers still points at registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/helm and the module resources assume the default provider. In the refactor I hoisted a root provider with `alias = \"helmcore\"` to split cluster creds, so implicit default got removed.

samir: quick question — can you paste the module call and the provider block you have now?

miriam: ```hcl
provider \"helm\" {
  alias = \"helmcore\"
  kubernetes {
    host                   = var.kube_host
    token                  = data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.kube_token.secret_string
  }
}

module \"helm_release\" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//helm?ref=split-helm"
  # no providers mapping here yet
}
```

pranav: Ok — modules that rely on the implicit provider will break when you only configure an aliased provider at root. Two options: 1) remove the alias and rely on default provider, or 2) explicitly pass providers = { helm = helm.helmcore } in the module call. Also if you changed provider source/version, regen the providers lockfile.

miriam: gonna try providers = { helm = helm.helmcore } first and regen lockfile. Any specific lock command?

samir: run `terraform init -upgrade` then `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64` to cover our CI agents. If you bumped provider source/version, lockfile format may update to v2 — fine, just mention it in the PR.

miriam: pushed quick change with explicit mapping + lockfile regen. PR in a sec.

jen: small note — prefer version range pin like `>= 2.6, < 3.0` instead of exact `= 2.6.1` unless we have a reason. And add a bullet in the CHANGELOG about hoisting provider aliases.

infra-bot: PR #4821 (infra/helm split): plan updated — 3 files changed. Staging plan succeeded (apply blocked by approvals). :robot_face:

miriam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 — PTAL @samir @pranav :raised_hands: I tested `terraform init -upgrade` and `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` locally, lockfile bumped to v2, plan is clean in staging.

samir: lgtm, quick approve. Did you also run `terraform fmt` and validate k8s manifests after helm release changes?

miriam: yep ran `make tf-fmt` + `make ci-validate` — no diffs.

pranav: I'll queue a canary deploy to payments-staging after merge and watch the helm release rollout. If the release fails we can roll back via the chart repo job.

jen: please add a one-line explanation in the PR description so the next refactor doesn't reintroduce the alias without mapping.

miriam: will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
